svg.title: Does removing title words change Marvel textual lookalikes?
svg.desc: One point per article: cosine with its ORIGINAL nearest neighbor before and after global title-word removal. The pair is held fixed on both axes. Color records whether this original neighbor remains the nearest among all 302 alternatives. Points below the diagonal became less similar; the chart measures sensitivity, not accuracy. 158 of 303 articles choose a different nearest neighbor after removal.

g.text: Hold each article’s original nearest-neighbor pair fixed; remove title words globally.
TF-IDF cosine · 303 frozen articles · no stopword list · title-word sensitivity, not semantic accuracy
